resources.string: Problem details
Complete compiler diagnostic
Compiler diagnostic
Read the complete diagnostic below. The original text is preserved for copying and troubleshooting.
Cannot resolve a declaration
Cannot resolve: %1$s
Check spelling, imports, declaration scope and downloaded project dependencies.
Arguments do not match the declaration
Compare argument count, order and types with the method or constructor declaration. Candidate signatures are alternatives.
Value type does not match the required type
Compare the actual and expected types in the complete diagnostic. Correct the value or declaration instead of adding an unsafe cast.
Syntax is incomplete or invalid
Check brackets, quotes and statement delimiters at the reported position. The complete diagnostic names the expected token.
An immutable value is being reassigned
An immutable value can only be initialized once. Change its declaration only if later changes are intended and safe.
Required initialization is missing
Initialize the property, field or variable and ensure it has a value on every path before it is used.
A required return value is missing
Return a value of the declared type on every required path, or correct the return type if the function should return no value.
Override declaration does not match its parent
Compare the name, parameters and return type with the parent declaration, then check override keywords or annotations.
A final declaration cannot be inherited or overridden
Check whether inheritance is intended and supported. Do not change a library declaration merely to silence this error.
An abstract member has not been implemented
Implement the required members. Mark the class abstract only if it is intended to remain incomplete and not be instantiated.
The when expression does not cover every case
Add the missing branches. Use else only when one fallback behavior is correct for every remaining case.
A declaration is not accessible here
Check visibility, package and module boundaries. Prefer an accessible API; change visibility only when you own the declaration and intend to expose it.
This API requires explicit opt-in
Read the experimental API requirements and the annotation named below before adding the appropriate @OptIn.
The compiler cannot infer a type
Check the supplied values and overloads. Add an explicit parameter, variable or generic type where the compiler lacks information.
Declarations conflict or are duplicated
Compare declaration names, signatures and imports. Rename or remove only the unintended duplicate after checking its usages.
A modifier is invalid or conflicts here
Check which modifiers this declaration permits. Remove duplicates or conflicting modifiers without changing unrelated declarations.
The property delegate lacks a required operator
Check the delegate type and getValue/setValue operators. For Compose delegation, also check the corresponding imports.
This API is deprecated
Read the suggested replacement in the declaration or diagnostic. Check behavior compatibility before replacing the API.
A declaration is not used
Check references and intended behavior before removing the declaration. An unused warning does not necessarily prevent compilation.
An instance member is used from a static context
Use an instance of the owning type, or reconsider whether the member is genuinely shared. Do not add static merely to silence the error.
A checked exception has not been handled
Handle the named exception with an appropriate try/catch, or declare throws if the caller is responsible for handling it.
This feature needs a different Java source level
Check the module source level and compiler support. Changing a displayed version number alone does not enable the feature.
